d:
Desh aaj sanvidhan divas mana raha hai. is avsar par tamam jaghon par karyakramon ka aayojan ho raha hai. bihar ke mukhyamantri samrat chaudhri ne betiya men karib do kilomitar lanbi padyatra ki. unhonne kaha ki bihar men loktantr bacha tha, aage bhi bachane ka kam kiya jaega. vahin, padyatra ke bad siem rajdevri men ek janasbha ko sanbodhit kiya. jahan unhonne kaee aham ghoshnaen kin.
